# omx phaser

The console's phaser: identical all-pass sections swept in octaves by one oscillator, with feedback around the chain and a wet/dry mix.

- CLAP id: `org.openmixer.phaser`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:phaser`
- Parameters: 6, plus the host's bypass

## Audio ports

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 2 (stereo) |
| out | out | main | 2 (stereo) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:phaser#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phaser | `phaser` | 1 | `Phaser` | 6 |

## Parameters

Ids are the order below, 0 to 5; the bypass takes the next id.

| Id | Symbol | Name | Unit | Min | Max | Default | Step or values | Flags | Page (priority) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `rateHz` | Rate | Hz | 0.05 | 5 | 0.5 | continuous, log | automatable | Phaser (1) |
| 1 | `baseHz` | Base | Hz | 50 | 2000 | 200 | whole steps | automatable | Phaser (1) |
| 2 | `depthOct` | Depth | oct | 0 | 6 | 4 | continuous, linear | automatable | Phaser (1) |
| 3 | `stages` | Stages |  | 2 | 12 | 6 | whole steps | automatable | Phaser (1) |
| 4 | `feedback` | Feedback |  | -0.9 | 0.9 | 0.4 | continuous, linear | automatable | Phaser (1) |
| 5 | `mix` | Mix | % | 0 | 100 | 50 | continuous, linear | automatable | Phaser (1) |

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 6, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`), 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; it comes after the parameter ports. The output port `latency` reports the latency in frames.
